topic.title: Higher Lower Game
topic.description: A game where the player guesses which celebrity has more social media followers. Uses lists of dictionaries, score tracking, and a continuous game loop.

learningNotes.whatILearned: Structuring data as a list of dictionaries, comparing values within dictionaries, and managing a score counter across game rounds.
learningNotes.challenges: Handling duplicate follower counts and ensuring the same celebrity is not selected twice.
learningNotes.nextSteps: Add a high-score tracker and fetch live data from an API.
